name: meridian
description: Meridian — the trust-first operating system for schools.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:setup && npm run seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.intelligence:install: cd intelligence && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
